title: Boggy Creek Airboat Adventures
specs: Explore the headwaters of the Everglades
Butterfly garden, gem mine, and Highland cow experience available
Private VIP tours available for groups

options.name: 1/2 Hour Tour
options.detail: Safe, exciting and educational airboat ride filled with surprises and fascination.

options.name: 1-Hour Tour
options.detail: Explore deeper into Florida’s natural beauty on a one-hour airboat adventure.

options.name: Supreme Package
options.detail: 1-hour airboat tour plus lunch, gem mine, park admission, butterfly nectar, and souvenir cup.

options.name: Sunset Tour
options.detail: Ride into the sunset to see the sun setting over the lake.

options.name: Night Tour
options.detail: One-hour ride through moonlit wetlands to see alligators and nocturnal wildlife.

options.name: Private Tour
options.detail: VIP tour reserving a captain and boat for your group, either thrill ride or nature tour.

explain.meaning: Only your group, with no other guests.

includes: Lunch with choice of side and sandwich (Supreme Package)
blurb: Guests take airboat rides exploring the Florida Everglades, with options including private tours, sunset rides, and nighttime tours. The park also offers additional experiences like a gem mine, butterfly garden, and a Highland cow attraction. Visitors can enjoy a lakeside meal at Boggy Bottom BBQ and explore a 32-acre park with wildlife and nature features.
extraNote: Check-in one hour prior for Sunset Tour
